concepts.way: misconception: When a loop finishes the program ends, so code after the loop never runs.
concepts.quote: The program ends when the loop ends.
concepts.why: The answer states this listed wrong rule: in Java, statements after a loop still run.

concepts.way: misconception: When a loop finishes the program ends, so code after the loop never runs.

concepts.way: contradicts line_by_line_trace: the program ends when main's last statement finishes
